name: Nihon Trim Co., Ltd.
summary: Nihon Trim Co., Ltd. develops and sells electrolyzed hydrogen water purifiers in Japan, Indonesia, and internationally. The company offers cartridges and electrolyzed hydrogen water apparatuses for households and livestock industries; electrolyzed water systems for agriculture; and electrolyzed water hemodialysis systems for medical care. It also manufactures and sells bottled water; and engages in research and development of electrolyzed hydrogen water. Nihon Trim Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
